Eight standards that make your website work for you

Web & software development9 October 2026·2 min read·Ampliq team

In this article

  1. Loading speed
  2. Mobile compatibility
  3. Right-to-left Arabic support
  4. Search engine optimization
  5. Security & SSL certificate
  6. Ease of use
  7. Scalability
  8. Analytics integration
  9. How do we start?

An outdated or slow website doesn’t reflect your value or turn visitors into customers. These are the standards we commit to on every site we build.

Many organizations have a website that doesn’t work for them: it’s slow, it doesn’t display well on mobile, or nobody knows how many visitors it turned into customers. A website today isn’t just a business card; it’s part of every marketing campaign you run.

We commit to these eight standards on every project, and you can use them to assess your current site.

Loading speed

Visitors don’t wait. A slow page means visitors leaving before they see your offer, and paid ads leading to a page that won’t load. So we compress images, load only what’s needed, and test speed on mobile.

Mobile compatibility

We design every element on the page to work on small screens — not a shrunken desktop layout — and test the site on mobile before launch.

Right-to-left Arabic support

An Arabic website isn’t a translation of an English one. Right-to-left layout, clear Arabic type, and mirrored arrows and icons are details that build trust with Arabic-speaking visitors.

Search engine optimization

A separate title and description for every page, in its own language; one main heading per page; short, clear URLs; and structured data that helps search engines understand the content.

Security & SSL certificate

An encrypted connection, regular updates and backups. Encryption is a basic requirement for visitor trust, and form data is only ever sent over it.

Ease of use

A clear journey from the home page to requesting a service: an understandable menu, buttons that say what they do, and short forms with clear error messages.

Scalability

We build the site so pages, services and languages can be added without rebuilding it, with a dashboard that lets your team update content themselves.

Analytics integration

A website whose results aren’t measured can’t be improved. We connect analytics tools and track key events — form submissions, phone and WhatsApp clicks — so you know where your customers come from.

How do we start?

We start every project with interface designs we approve with you before development, then hand over the site with a dashboard, training for your team, and a warranty and technical support after launch.
